dedupeResult: The complete accessible open pull-request patch and repository code search returned no match for either platform, domain, canonical submission route or the KWDC submission mailbox before creation. Each platform was consolidated into one canonical program.
emailVerificationLevel: KWDC's submission mailbox was verified only by first-party publication, syntax, explicit purpose and Delta College domain alignment. Qfm publishes no submission mailbox and directs artists to its contact form. No SMTP, MX, catch-all, mailbox-level or deliverability probing was performed.
formVerificationLevel: KWDC links a Google consent form and a consent PDF, neither of which was passively retrievable; its primary route is the published email workflow. Qfm publicly renders name, email, subject and message fields and instructs artists to paste a WeTransfer or Dropbox link. No login, CAPTCHA or payment was visible on the first-party pages, but hidden live controls remain unverified.
safety: Both opportunities were queued as needs_manual_review. No form field was filled, no consent was signed, no file or ZIP was uploaded, no email was sent, no account or login was used, no CAPTCHA was solved and no payment or submission action was completed.
